categories.main_business_segments: SiteOne operates as a single reportable segment, serving as the largest and only national full product line wholesale distributor of landscape supplies in the United States, with a growing presence in Canada. Its business encompasses the distribution of irrigation supplies, fertilizer and control products, hardscapes, landscape accessories, nursery goods, outdoor lighting, and ice melt products to green industry professionals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core operations center on a vast distribution network, leveraging over 630 branches, four major distribution centers, and a fleet of more than 2,200 delivery vehicles. SiteOne utilizes a single technology platform for procurement, inventory management, and financial support, and has invested in digital initiatives such as a B2B e-commerce platform and advanced inventory and transportation management systems. Proprietary brands like LESCO, SiteOne Green Tech, and Pro-Trade supplement its third-party product offerings.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SiteOne’s primary customers are residential and commercial landscape professionals, including contractors specializing in design, installation, and maintenance of outdoor spaces, as well as golf courses and municipal agencies. The customer base is highly diversified, with over 290,000 firms and individuals, and no single customer accounting for more than 2% of net sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: SiteOne operates in 45 U.S. states and six Canadian provinces, with over 630 branch locations and four major distribution centers strategically located across North America. The company has a particularly strong presence in major metropolitan areas and continues to expand through acquisitions.
categories.supply_chain_position: SiteOne functions as a downstream distributor, acting as a critical link between over 5,000 suppliers and landscape professionals. The company provides both branch-based and direct distribution models, offering local availability of products in quantities suited to customer needs and facilitating bulk logistics for large projects.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding through organic growth and acquisitions, enhancing supply chain efficiency, broadening product lines (including private label expansion), and advancing digital and operational excellence initiatives. The company invests in technology, data analytics, and e-commerce, and focuses on category management, sales force effectiveness, and customer loyalty programs.
categories.revenue_model: SiteOne generates revenue primarily through the sale of landscape supply products to professional customers, with additional value-added consultative services provided at no separate charge. Revenue streams include both in-branch and direct distribution sales, with a small portion from proprietary branded products and loyalty programs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SiteOne is the only national distributor offering a full product line in the highly fragmented landscape supply industry, where most competitors are regional or local private businesses. Major competitors include Heritage Landscape Supply Group, Ewing, Horizon Distributors, Harrell’s, BWI, Target Specialty Products, Howard Fertilizer and Chemical, Central Turf and Irrigation Supply, and BFG Supply. SiteOne’s national scale, breadth of products, and service capabilities differentiate it from competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal year 2022, SiteOne reported net sales of $4.0 billion, a 16% increase over the prior year, with organic daily sales growth of 11%. Net income was $245.4 million, up 3% year-over-year. The company has demonstrated consistent double-digit growth in recent years, driven by both organic expansion and acquisitions, and maintains a strong balance sheet with significant liquidity and borrowing capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SiteOne’s value proposition centers on its comprehensive product selection, national footprint, high-touch customer service, and value-added consultative services. The company’s ability to offer a full range of landscape supplies, proprietary brands, technical expertise, and loyalty programs, combined with reliable delivery and digital tools, provides a one-stop solution for landscape professionals and distinguishes it from regional and local competitors.
